b3628b4be46b: MultiDatePick makes no-code bookings, calendars and Gantt charts for any Salesforce object, 100% native on Salesforce.
fd90422f39f9: MultiDatePick puts bookings, calendars and Gantt charts on any Salesforce object with no code. Book: rooms, people and equipment for your own team, with capacity and conflict checks so nothing is double booked. Pick: many dates on one record, with ranges, recurring patterns and time slots, each saved as its own record. Plan: projects in a Gantt chart with dependencies, a critical path and planned dates, plus timeline and utilization views that show who is overloaded. Seven views of the same records (month calendar, resource timeline, week grid, utilization heatmap, agenda, map and Gantt chart), 150+ settings set up in a guided Setup Wizard, 47 ready-made configs and 9 languages.
